newsitem.title: USA: Aradigm insulin delivery tests positive.
newsitem.headline: Aradigm insulin delivery tests positive.

text.p: Aradigm Corp said a study of its AERx noninvasive insulin delivery system found the reduced blood glucose levels in half the time of injectable methods.

AERx, which is delivered by way of inhaling, releases insulin as an aerosol, which the company says allows it to reach peripheral areas of the lung, providing for a quick absorption into the bloodstream.

The company said that based on the results of the feasibility study, it will continue its investigation of the system. It is currently conducting with an undisclosed corporate partner preclinical studies of the system in combination with an additional protein drug.
